title: HOTTY Catalog
description: Keys, forms and focus for A2UI surfaces shown in a terminal: the hotty catalog of the HOTTY profile of A2UI. Mix it with the basic catalog component by component.
instructions:
These components come from the hotty catalog: give each one "catalogId": "https://neuroplast.io/hotty/a2ui/v1/catalog.json". Everything else comes from the basic catalog.

1. Shortcut binds a key to its surface. Put it anywhere in the tree (it draws nothing). Give either `press`, the id of a Button on the same surface, or `action`. Write keys as W3C key values joined by '+': "Control+s", "Escape", "Alt+ArrowDown", "F5". Prefer keys with Control or Alt: a bare printable key does nothing while the user is typing in a field.

2. Form wraps fields (TextField and the like, usually in a Column) and runs `onSubmit` when the user presses Enter in one of them. Do not add a submit Button just for Enter; a Button inside a Form is still an ordinary Button.

3. To move the keyboard to a component, call focus(id) from a Button's action, or send callRendererFunction. blur() gives the keyboard back to the terminal.

4. To focus a component when the surface first appears, set "metadata": {"extensions": {"io_neuroplast_hotty": {"autofocus": true}}} on it.

Shortcut.description: Binds a key to its surface and draws nothing. When the key is pressed while its surface is the active one, it presses the Button named by `press`, as a click would and only if that Button's checks pass, or it runs `action`. A key that types a character with no modifier but Shift does nothing while a text control has the keyboard.

key.description: The key: a W3C UI Events key value, after the modifiers it needs, joined by '+'. The modifiers are Control, Alt, Shift and Meta. Examples: "Control+s", "Escape", "Alt+ArrowUp", "F5". Tab and Shift+Tab move focus, and cannot be bound.

press.description: The id of a Button on this surface. The key presses it as a click would. A plain id, not a ComponentId: the Shortcut does not contain the Button.

action.description: What the key does, when it presses no Button.

label.description: What the key does, in a word or two, for a renderer that lists the keys a surface takes.

Form.description: A container of fields. Enter in a text field inside it runs `onSubmit`, if the Form's checks pass. Fields inside it commit their values before `onSubmit`'s context is resolved.

child.description: The form's content, usually a Column of fields.

weight.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column, as CSS 'flex-grow'.

focus.description: Gives the keyboard to a component of the surface: the user's next keys go to it. On a HOTTY host it is a=focus.

id.description: The id of the component to focus. A template's component takes the instance in the caller's scope.

blur.description: Gives the keyboard back to the terminal. A field that had it commits its value first. On a HOTTY host it is a=blur.
